steps.content: This battle drags on without end.

You're no stranger to fighting the Tide of Ashes, and the battle plans have long been prepared with FAC. You've seized the initiative, outmaneuvering and overwhelming the enemy at every turn. Yet despite your efforts, no one expected their sheer numbers—hours of relentless combat, and still, victory remains out of reach.

Though small in scale, the Apostles spill endlessly from the Mania flower in the man's left hand—as if a rift had torn open, bridging this world to hell. Is this the power of the Underground? And how many more of these "flowers" lie waiting?

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Not many, rest assured. Even THAT ONE cannot bestow gifts endlessly upon others.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Only four Sages wielding this power would suffice to bring you considerable... inconvenience.

He sees right through your anxiety, answering with effortless calm. A thin crimson barrier divides him from the battlefield, shielding him as he observes the chaos beyond. Yet his gaze lingers on you, strangely alight with admiration.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Hmm... impressive. DisCity's resilience is not yet extinguished, it seems. This will only harden the Senate's resolve.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Nirvana will have their full support—whatever means are required to secure the West District mine. Once the Hypercubes are under their control, a new order will follow.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So if you can't take DisCity by force, you're just going to push this "two-city alliance" instead?

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: This has always been one of the advised strategies.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Looking at the current securities market, Nirvana's stock price has far outpaced all competitors. They've undeniably become the darling of the market. This plan is nearly complete.

You could gather evidence against them, investigate them, and unravel the conspiracy piece by piece, but you can also imagine the countless obstacles lying in wait. Worse yet, you'd never know what Nirvana might do to the West District mine while you're caught up in that struggle.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Your internal vulnerability is plain to see. Competing interests paralyze progress, each faction too busy guarding its own spoils to notice the rot. Why waste bullets when greed is enough to do most of the work? Today's DisCity is truly riddled with flaws—decayed and fragile.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...You're right. I'm not that familiar with DisCity's high-society games. If you managed to get that contract signed, my friends and I would definitely be on the back foot.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: From what I've heard, these financial games are all about surprises and thrills... Not really my thing, but maybe someone else can.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: As you said, "Competing interests paralyze progress, each faction too busy guarding its own spoils." It's DisCity's flaw... but in a way, maybe that's what keeps it running.
[News]

steps.speaker: Newscast
steps.content: Breaking news rocks the city this hour as terror strikes again. Outlands extremists have launched a brazen attack on today's closing ceremony with hundreds wounded and dozens feared dead. The Commander-in-Chief's motorcade was also targeted.

steps.speaker: Newscast
steps.content: Renowned stock market guru Parfait has vanished under mysterious circumstances, failing to appear at a scheduled high-profile dinner. The unexpected disappearance has directly impacted Nirvana's technology acquisition and West District mine activation plans.

steps.speaker: Newscast
steps.content: What could make her walk away from such a golden opportunity? Was it a loss of confidence in the project? Or is there more to this story? And the bigger question—after disappearing without a trace... where is she now?

steps.speaker: Newscast
steps.content: ...What? Parfait has been found? She's on a helicopter fleeing the city? A deliberate escape—what's really going on here??

steps.speaker: Newscast
steps.content: What?!!! She was harboring an Outlander?
[Transition] (Aerial night view of DisCity)

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: Th-this is...??

The wind shrieks around the helicopter as it carves through the sky, weaving between skyscrapers before sweeping over WhiteSands. Gritty sand pelts the thundering rotors, the relentless barrage crackling like gunfire.
Sibilla stares wide-eyed at the unfamiliar scene before her, while the woman who whisked her aboard grips the control stick, her face alight with unrestrained excitement.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Oh! Don't look so surprised, my friend. I once took helicopter lessons on a private island in West DisCity. Let's be real, what's life without a little thrill?

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: No, that's not what I meant. Where are we going?

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Isn't it obvious? Away from DisCity, of course.
<size=36><color=#7683a2>...Run away?</color></size>
The word strikes a powerful chord within her. In an instant, haunting memories flood back—death, fear, loneliness, suffocation—awakened one after another.
[Series of flashbacks with white flashes]

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: They operate under clever disguises—the Great Expo personnel, merchant caravans, and even Outland refugees—all to infiltrate DisCity, using a calculated blend of truth and lies to cultivate sympathy and trust.

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: Screw off! Who's got time for beggar trash like you?

steps.speaker: Passerby B
steps.content: Pfft, why'd you stop the act? At least be professional with your sob story. Go on, keep it up.

steps.speaker: Arienna
steps.content: They don't understand our suffering—they can't even imagine it.

steps.speaker: Arienna
steps.content: People living in a different world simply cannot see our pain.

<size=36>...Run?</size>

<size=45>...Run.</size>

<size=52>—RUN!!!</size>
Since the day she set foot on the path of exile, that word has clung to her like a nightmare.
So, she's long since gotten used to it.
The answer is there all along.

She gazes at the boundless expanse of WhiteSands, at the calamities raging on the horizon, and at the battlefield still burning nearby—while her homeland and everyone she knows remain thousands of miles away. Sibilla clutches the protective charm tightly, the same one that has stayed with her through every step of her journey.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: I... don't want to run anymore.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: I'm not afraid to die, and I don't want to run away. This isn't how it ends. Turn around! We go back! There's still so much left to do. I'm not giving up! There has to be another way! It's not over yet! Let me go back—
The night glass reflects Sibilla's expression, and Parfait watches, satisfaction glinting in her eyes.
Even across vast distances and divergent paths, those of true golden quality will always shine—and DisCity's stock market guru never fails to praise her own eye for talent.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Haha, running away? I never said so. I see immense value in you. Why would I ever let that go to waste?
She grips the control stick tightly.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Hold on tight, my Outland friend. Now, Parfait Medici is about to put on a grand show.
A swarm of drones has closed in on the helicopter, their loudspeakers blaring relentless messages.

steps.speaker: Pursuing Media
steps.content: We found her! Parfait—!! Are you okay?! Say something if you can hear us! Stock Market Guru—!! Quick, get the cameras on her now! See what's happening inside the helicopter—Huh?!!

steps.speaker: Pursuing Media
steps.content: We've got footage from inside the cockpit. That pilot... It's actually Parfait herself! No kidnapping, no coercion... she's flying the helicopter out of DisCity, ditching her own dinner party and investments. This makes no sense! Why would she do this?!

steps.speaker: Pursuing Media
steps.content: Wait, there's someone else on the aircraft... an Outlander?? And looks like a homeless beggar??

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: I know that Outlander... She showed up at the Great Expo. Could it be...

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Parfait got some critical information from her?
The longer Thalia contemplates the situation, the more intriguing it seems. A slow, knowing smile curves across her lips.

steps.speaker: Thalia
steps.content: Perfect! Looks like you've finally found the key to getting attention in DisCity. How lucky! Now, let me just... add a little spark to the moment. You better not waste this opportunity!

With a covert flick of her power, her viewer count soars to staggering heights, while explosive comments surge across the screen in an unrelenting tide. No one can throttle the news related to the stock market guru, after all.
[Comments explode across the screen]

steps.speaker: Pursuing Media
steps.content: Huh? Wait—Parfait's standing up. Did she just switch to autopilot?!! Ladies and gentlemen, Parfait has spotted us! She's coming out and she's... she's trying to wave us off?

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Go away! GO AWAY!! Stop following us!

steps.speaker: Pursuing Media
steps.content: What's happening?! Parfait looks extremely agitated. She's desperately trying to shield that Outlander? It's like... she's hiding something. Could it be...

steps.speaker: Pursuing Media
steps.content: Could that Outlander actually be connected to the Nirvana-Fraser collaboration?! What kind of bombshell does she have that's big enough to make even the stock market guru ditch her own dinner party and investment plans? This can't be just some minor leak... it's got to be massive profits, groundbreaking secrets, market-shaking news—oh my God!!

steps.speaker: Pursuing Media
steps.content: Outlander!! Hey! Say something, Outlander!!
Before Sibilla can even react, Parfait lunges forward to block the camera, shouting loudly.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: No comment! No interviews!! This has nothing to do with the stock market! She has no connection to Nirvana or Fraser! Go away!!
Parfait's agitation only ignites everyone's curiosity, making them even more convinced of their own suspicions!

steps.speaker: Pursuing Media
steps.content: Aha! Just look at that reaction! I was right—this Outlander is definitely sitting on a huge story!

steps.speaker: Pursuing Media
steps.content: Hey, friend from the Outlands, don't be afraid. We're nothing like Parfait! We're here to help you, and every investor in DisCity has your back! Just tell us what happened—why did she kidnap you?! This is about Nirvana's investments, right?

steps.speaker: Pursuing Media
steps.content: Tell us!! Say it loud!! Everyone's listening!

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: No comment! No interviews!! She's mine, don't follow us! Or I'll attack! I—

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Ahhh!!
[Money Scattering CG]

steps.speaker: Pursuing Media
steps.content: All... all DisCity investors... you're not seeing things... What we're filming right now... will shock the entire city...

steps.speaker: Pursuing Media
steps.content: <color=#fb9259><size=52>SHE'S RAINING HYPERCUBES!!!! WOAHHHH—</color></size>

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: My private mine—my golden opportunity—all gone—!
Sibilla stares, mouth wide open, as Parfait theatrically beats her chest and stamps her feet. But beneath the dramatic display, she catches a witty gleam in the stock market guru's eyes.
[Flashback] On the helicopter, before the hypercube rain commotion

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: You see, Sibilla, this is what DisCity people want to hear. Understand them well enough, and you'll have their hearts in your grip, just like how you've got that little bit of leverage against me.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Look outside. If you can cross such a vast desert, you can certainly breach the walls around people's hearts—you just need the right tricks.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: People may not share their joys and sorrows, but understanding? That's a two-way street. And the truly clever ones take the first step. After all, isn't that how you steer the game?

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Now, my Outland friend, think about what kind of story you're going to tell. Don't get lost in telling your story—tell one that captivates all of DisCity.
[Big CG: Smiling Parfait]

Beneath her theatrical demeanor, Parfait lifts her hand slightly, a single half-lidded eye glinting from the shadows. Just as the people of DisCity believe that wealth is measured in currency—which allows her to fabricate "money"—so too can she maintain this fabrication, as long as more come to believe survival itself equals Hypercubes.
It is enough to satisfy the drone cameras. Her gamble has paid off.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: I've placed my bet—all in on you. Now, my friend, the ball's in your court. Still got enough breath to blow that whistle?

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: ...Of course. Thank you.
[Black Screen]
Sibilla takes a deep breath, never before having received this much attention.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: ...Fraser never developed Aurum Secretum to protect civilians! The whole "partnership" is just a scam to steal Nirvana's Hypercube mining technology!!

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: They're stealing your technology! To make a Black Ring! To produce their own Hypercubes!!

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: Yes, Fraser has already built their own Black Ring! They're secretly producing Hypercubes and planning to completely replace you!
The news spreads like wildfire. AI-generated headlines flood the network, their ripple effects surging even faster across every field.
<size=60>"Nirvana Brutally Deceived by Fraser"</size>
<size=60>"Outland Black Ring Returns: Humanity Faces Extinction!"</size>
<size=60>"Crisis and Opportunity for DisCity—New Hypercubes!"</size>
<size=60>"Shocking Revelation: Why Has Investment Guru Parfait Abandoned DisCity!"</size>
<size=60>"Nirvana Stocks in Free Fall: The Shocking Source of Mysterious Short Selling!"</size>
<color=#fb9259><size=80>At 7:48 PM, with only 12 minutes left until market close, Nirvana stocks plummet!!</size></color>
[The Silent Incense]

- So we got played? Fraser had their own mine this whole time and still tried to screw us over for our money and tech?! - I told you from the start. Working with Fraser was like a cure worse than the disease. That intel from the extremists is useless the whole time. - There are Hypercubes out there too? And nobody thought to mention that in any of our meetings? I poured resources into Outland transport for nothing. So what, am I just a joke now? - Relax... Fraser might think they're being smart, but what about their stake in DisCity? You really think they'd cut ties completely? Is that even possible?

- And what about Parfait? She slipped away clean, while we're stuck cleaning up her mess? - That woman definitely knows about this information all along! - She never makes a move unless she's sure. That clean of an escape... She's probably already cut a deal with Campbell to short us together. - Hump, what a "master of credit"! Can anyone still contact Campbell? Whatever it takes, bring her back here!

- You're still arguing? What about the new mine? If we don't force activation now, who will still take Nirvana seriously? - Get your men on PR immediately! Just tell people Nirvana holds a higher-purity Hypercube refining method and Fraser's is just a knockoff that can't handle mass production! - Look, Parfait's gone, stocks are crashing, and the public's going wild. At this point, we'd better start figuring out our explanations.

steps.speaker: Sillage
steps.content: ...Heh... hahahahaha! You really are fearless, aren't you? I like that!

steps.speaker: Sillage
steps.content: While your "believers" hunt for Furor, weave them another story of wealth. Convince them it's real. You've done it before. You'll do it again.

steps.speaker: Sillage
steps.content: Just as I've believed you wouldn't disappoint, and you would keep surprising me. Today proved it delightfully.

steps.speaker: Sillage
steps.content: Now, my dear Campbell friend, what will you do next?
Several people come charging in, kicking open the Executive Committee's door with a single blow.

steps.speaker: Nirvana Representative
steps.content: No! I refuse to accept this!! Parfait would never do such a thing! She must have been taken hostage!! Rescue her first, then we'll talk!

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Be patient, Representative. This is no small matter. In DisCity, Nirvana has more enemies than you realize. For the sake of your corporation, you must endure this.
The new Speaker surveys the room, having to make a conscious effort this time to maintain his composure and hold his smile back.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: It is with profound regret that I must declare the Aurum Secretum collaboration is hereby suspended. The cabinet will oversee and verify all subsequent investigations.

steps.speaker: Max King
steps.content: Chief Lang, Chief Lotherlon, you may proceed.

steps.speaker: Lotherlon
steps.content: No problem!

steps.speaker: Lang
steps.content: ...Hmph, not bad.
Little does anyone know that the Speaker of the City Council still holds a message from ${PlayerName}, delivered to him that night by Miss Stewart.
—An invitation from someone else.

The irrational bubble has overflowed the golden chalice. This time, Parfait's Dinner Party seeks to be more refreshing, to spread happiness to even greater numbers. So... Would you honor me with your presence at this exclusive, grand short-selling soirée?
You're welcome to bring a few friends along, if you'd like.
Even someone like him still has a few friends, and those who hold a grudge against Nirvana are hardly scarce.
[Scene Change] Battlefield
Of course, you wouldn't know about any of this. After all, you don't currently have access to communication networks.
But as Adelaide's expression shifts from focus to surprise, then softens into a sigh as he lowers his gaze, you suspect that your side has claimed victory.
I've got all the time in the world—whether it's here in this fight, or after I take you back and slowly wear down whoever's pulling your strings.
...I will win.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Indeed, you've prevailed. I concede without reservation.
